messages:
olivia_sales: Hi all — Cobalt wants a hosted API key for a 2-hour workshop and a longer POC. Ask: short-lived (5d) demo key, rotate at day 2, allowlist 198.51.100.0/24, pre-demo refresh 30m, audit logs with prompt redaction, and an explicit revoke proof we can share with their security team. Demo in ~24h.

sam_se: Quick q: do they need a separate read-only telemetry token for their SREs? We can issue two tokens (main + read-only). Also, ephemeral vs workspace-scoped? Ephemeral preferred by their infra lead.

olivia_sales: They prefer ephemeral for security optics but want the team not to worry about mid-demo rotation. Can we do ephemeral with an automatic pre-demo renewal window and a one-click safety kill switch?

tariq_sec: Security requirements: redact PII in logs, 90d retention for audit, webhook to notify both #sales and the approver on revoke. Also require an evidence artifact for revoke tests (request-id and timestamp). Approval ticket COBALT-POC-112 exists.

ops_jen: We can create an ephemeral hosted key bound to the workspace and allowlist, schedule rotation at 2d, and a pre-demo refresh 30m before start. We'll also emit a webhook on revoke and add automation to auto-revoke if ticket state -> blocked. I'll provision now. Internal ops CLI (for audit only):

```
# ops-only
redwoodctl keys create \
  --workspace cobalt-poc \
  --owner olivia_sales \
  --name cobalt-demo-2533 \
  --ttl 5d \
  --rotate-after 2d \
  --pre-demo-refresh 30m \
  --allowlist 198.51.100.0/24 \
  --redact-logs true \
  --audit-retention 90d \
  --notify-webhook https://hooks.redwood.sales/cobalt/revoke \
  --extra-metadata cors=https://workshop.cobalt.example
```

notifbot: Created key: key_COB2533xyz (expires 2026-06-10T09:12:00Z). Rotation scheduled in 2 days. Pre-demo refresh at 2026-06-08T08:42:00Z. Audit logging enabled (redaction: true). Webhook configured.

sam_se: I'll DM the main key to olivia via secure channel. Reminder: do not paste the key into customer chat. Also provisioning a read-only monitoring token for telemetry:read-only.

ops_jen: Created monitoring token: key_COB_MON2533 (scope: telemetry:read, expires same as main).

olivia_sales: Thanks. Can we run a quick "safety kill" test now so I can send the evidence to Cobalt's security team? They want to see the revoke happen and a follow-up failed request showing 401, plus a reissue proving 200 again. Keep outputs redacted except request-id/timestamp.

ops_jen: Sure — will perform safety-kill and post redacted proof here. Steps: 1) revoke main token, 2) run test call (expect 401), 3) reissue token, 4) run test call (expect 200). Example revoke CLI: `redwoodctl keys revoke key_COB2533xyz --reason "safety_test"`. Test curl (redacted):

```
# after revoke (expected 401)
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer key_COB2533xyz" https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate

# after reissue (expected 200)
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer key_COB2533NEW" https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate
```

ops_jen: Performing revoke now...

notifbot: Revoke event: key_COB2533xyz revoked by ops_jen (reason: safety_test) at 2026-06-08T08:10:12Z. Webhook POSTed to https://hooks.redwood.sales/cobalt/revoke.

ops_jen: Post-revoke test result (redacted): request-id: r-9b7c1a, timestamp: 2026-06-08T08:10:13Z, response: 401 Unauthorized (token invalid).

ops_jen: Reissuing key now...

notifbot: New key created: key_COB2533NEW (expires 2026-06-10T09:15:00Z).

ops_jen: Post-reissue test result (redacted): request-id: r-9b7c1b, timestamp: 2026-06-08T08:11:05Z, response: 200 OK (generation accepted). Logs captured and saved to audit with redaction.

tariq_sec: Evidence looks good. I'll attach the redacted logs and the revoke webhook delivery to the approval ticket COBALT-POC-112. That satisfies our checklist.

olivia_sales: Perfect — can you package the one-page "credential ceremony + safety proof" with the curl snippets (redacted) and send to me? I'll forward to Cobalt security.

ops_jen: Done — DM sent to olivia_sales with the one-pager and attached redacted audit snippets. Automation added: if ticket -> blocked, system auto-revokes and posts reason to #sales.

olivia_sales: Thanks team! Sharing with Cobalt now. Will update after their workshop. :white_check_mark:
